k:滝.mnemonic: A dragon (竜) dives off the cliff, and its long white body is a tsunami (氵) of water pouring straight down into the pool. Waterfall (rapids, cascade).
k:滝.hint: A white dragon diving off a cliff.

k:泥.mnemonic: After the tsunami (氵), the flag (尸) lies flat in brown slop so thick that you could lift it with a spoon (匕). Mud (mire, adhere to, be attached to).

k:喫.mnemonic: A mouth (口) makes a pledge (契): I will finish everything on this table, the food, the tea and the pipe. Consume (eat, drink, smoke).
k:喫.hint: A promise to finish the table.

k:随.mnemonic: The guide crossing the mound (阝) is the only one to have (有) a lantern, so everyone else on the path (辶) walks right at his heels. Follow (though, notwithstanding, while).

k:揺.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) push a bucket that hangs from a claw (爪) hook over a dry (干) pit (凵), and it rocks back and forth on its rope. Swing (shake, sway, rock).

k:麦.mnemonic: A tall stalk with three rows of bristly whiskers at the top, and roots striding out below like legs. This is the bearded grain of the field. Barley (wheat).
k:麦.hint: A bearded stalk with striding roots.

k:恩.mnemonic: A cause (因) resting on a heart (心). Someone was kind to you once, and that is the cause of the warm debt your heart still carries. Grace (kindness, goodness, favor).
k:恩.hint: A warm debt on the heart.

k:酔.mnemonic: Nine (九) cups from the wine jar (酉) was already plenty. Cup number ten (十) has him swaying and singing to the lamp post. Drunk (feel sick, poisoned, elated).
k:酔.hint: The tenth cup from the jar.

k:祈.mnemonic: A woodcutter lays his axe (斤) on the altar (礻) before going into the forest, bows his head, and asks to come home safe. Pray (wish).

k:透.mnemonic: Glassmakers who excel (秀) make a pane so fine that you see the path (辶) on the other side as if nothing were in the way. Transparent (permeate, filter, penetrate).
k:透.hint: Seeing the road through perfect glass.

k:佳.mnemonic: The leader (亻) inspects soil (土) piled on soil, dark and rich and two layers deep, and gives the farm top marks. Excellent (beautiful, good, pleasing).

k:紋.mnemonic: A sentence (文) about who the family is, stitched in thread (糸) onto every robe as one round emblem. Family crest (figures).

k:侍.mnemonic: When a leader (亻) visits the temple (寺), someone stands quietly at his elbow, ready to bring whatever he asks for. Waiter (samurai, wait upon, serve).

k:贈.mnemonic: It is your special day (日). One guest brings a share of the rice field (田) harvest, another brings shellfish (貝) money, and all of it comes wrapped with a bow. Presents (send, give to, award to).

k:麗.mnemonic: A deer (鹿) steps out of the mist wearing a little hood (冂) ornament on each antler. Everyone on the road stops to look. Lovely (beautiful, graceful, resplendent).
k:麗.hint: Deer with ornaments on its antlers.

k:塗.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of water stirred into soil (土) makes plaster. Following the book (本) of instructions, you get it jammed in (介) every crack and smear it flat. Paint (plaster, daub, smear).

k:鎮.mnemonic: A heavy paperweight of true (真) gold (金) is set down on the fluttering pages, and everything under it goes still. Tranquilize (ancient peace-preservation centers).

k:旋.mnemonic: A bolt (疋) of cloth tied to a pole whirls in the wind, pointing in one direction (方) after another until it has gone all the way around. Rotation (go around).

k:乾.mnemonic: A thousand (千) times dawn (旦) has come without a cloud in the sky. The ground has cracked and the wells give only dust. Drought (dry, desiccate, drink up).

k:拳.mnemonic: A hand (手) raised toward heaven (天) with all the fingers curled in tight, shaken at the sky. Fist.

k:妨.mnemonic: A woman (女) is trying to work, and from every direction (方) somebody calls her name. She cannot finish a single line. Disturb (prevent, hamper, obstruct).
k:妨.hint: Called from all sides at once.

k:誇.mnemonic: He will say (言) anything, as long as it is big (大): even his cradle (勹), he tells you, was the biggest in the village. Boast (be proud, pride, triumphantly).

k:甚.mnemonic: The cake was so sweet (甘) that the children who ate it are now all legs (儿), running laps around the house and up the walls. Tremendously (very, great, exceedingly).

k:謀.mnemonic: Behind a tree (木), two people say (言) sweet (甘) things to each other in whispers about how to trick a third. Conspire (cheat, impose on, plan).

k:径.mnemonic: Stroll (彳) straight across the circle of soil (土), right through the middle, and also (又) count your steps. That is how wide the circle is. Diameter (path, method, road).

k:凍.mnemonic: The east (東) wind blows all night and hangs icicles (冫) on everything it touches. By morning the pond is solid. Frozen (congeal, refrigerate).

k:冒.mnemonic: Stare straight at the day (日) sun with a bare eye (目). It is a dare, and you may not see so well afterwards. Risk (face, defy, dare).
k:冒.hint: Bare eye staring at the sun.

k:脅.mnemonic: Power (力), power, power: three bullies stacked on top of you, saying you have one month (月) to pay up. Threaten (coerce).

k:措.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) close the storybook at the words once upon a time (昔) and slide it onto the shelf for another night. Set aside (give up, suspend, discontinue).

k:箇.mnemonic: Bamboo (竹) strips left to harden (固) become tally sticks, and you lay one down for each separate thing you count. Item counter (counter for articles).
